name: Bodily Fluid Exposure Incident Notification
description: Employees report every incident of exposure to bodily fluids and any student health condition or behavior that presents a reasonable risk of transmitting infection.
recipient: Superintendent or designee, building principal, and school nurse
quote: Employees shall notify the Superintendent or designee, building principal, and school nurse of all incidents of exposure to bodily fluids and when a student’s health condition or behavior presents a reasonable risk of transmitting an infection.
